dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Special Lecture Hall
大观园 特殊教室
dataList.content:
Wow, he's really taken a liking to her.
他看起来……特别开心呢。

Yeah. He wouldn't stop crying when we tried to get him to calm down...
是啊。明明我们想哄他的时候他还一直哭……

Besides... how's she even doing that with her hands? Not even masters of martial arts move like that.
不如说……那手势是怎么回事？感觉就算是武艺登峰造极之人也做不到那样吧。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Ryōshū was practically giving him no time for any other distractions, or even a moment to cry—she was taking care of that kid almost effortlessly.
良秀正熟练地哄着孩子……让孩子无暇哭泣或思考其他事情。

She was employing all kinds of tactics, including but not limited to ventriloquism... kongzhu, a traditional Hongyuan toy...
从使用人偶的腹语术……鸿园的传统玩具空竹……

... fan tricks... sugared fruits... and eventually...
到扇子戏法和果脯，经过这一系列折腾……

Hee hee~
嘿嘿。

Don't pull too hard.
别太用力拽。

The child ended up piggybacking on Ryōshū, the fear he showed earlier gone without a trace.
几分钟前害怕的样子完全不见了踪影，那孩子像口香糖一样紧紧黏在了良秀的身后。

Never would've imagined Ryōshū would be good at this... neat.
完全没想到良秀小姐这么会照顾孩子……真是不可思议。

And with the exact same expression as her usual one, Ryōshū was gently caressing the child. Well, to be more exact, she was giving him a gentle pat.
良秀用一如既往的表情，抚摸着孩子的头……不，准确地说，是轻轻地、放松地拍打着。

But... I think I get it.
但是……我明白哄孩子的方法了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Showering kids with tasty stuff and gifts isn't the best way to go about it—what's important is helping them understand just what kind of person I am.
与其因为他们是孩子而盲目地用食物或礼物诱惑他们……不如让他们知道我是什么样的人。
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Yeah, the kid's really on edge for his age. I'd start to make some progress, but whenever he suspected that I was lying or something, he'd immediately go back to being on guard.
他的洞察力很强，如果他觉得我在撒谎，即使刚变得亲近了一些，他也会立刻对我保持警惕，很伤脑筋。

... That's also because he's a Daguanyuan kid. Kids... don't survive this place for long if they're not quick on the uptake.
……他是大观园的孩子，才会更加如此。因为这里……是不这样就无法活下去的地方。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan

dataList.content:
Venerable Hierarch... m-may I ask you something...?
家主大人……我、我能拜托您一件事吗……？

Well, asking's free, but I gotta tell you, it's going to depend on what you're about to ask whether I can help you or not.
看情况吧……想要拜托的事尽管提就好，但我会不会听就要看你所说的内容了。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Wrong move, rookie Hierarch. Why say all that when T.W.D.T? You don't get the immaculacy of succinct abbreviations.
错，毛孩家主。应该用一·言结束的……看来你不懂缩略的精髓啊。

Ryōshū grabbed the child's shoulders, brought him before Jia Xichun, then, in her usual curtness, spoke precisely two words to the confused child, and that seemed to do the trick. 良秀不知何时抓住了孩子的肩膀，将他放在了贾惜春面前……然后像往常一样，她对着一脸茫然的孩子脱口而出一句非常简短的话。

Speak, kid.
总之先说吧。

Ah! I-it's, uhm, my big sis said that when the Family Hierarch war's over, I can finally play tons with friends...
啊！是、是这样的。姐姐说过，家主之争结束之后，我就可以和朋友好~好地玩个够了……

... but their parents told em to stay inside 'cuz it's too dangerous outside...
但是呢……朋友们的父母说外面很危险，所以不让他们出门……

dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
My cousin says you're the biggest and the baddest of Hongyuan, venerable Hierarch...
堂哥说……家主大人……是鸿园最~厉害的人。

... so I wanted to ask if... you can make Daguanyuan safe? I wanna play with my friends...
好想和朋友们一起玩啊……要是大观园……没那么危险就好了……

... Gotcha. I'll review your suggestion positively.
……明白了。我会积极商讨你的请求的。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
She says she'll totally make that happen.
家主大人说她绝对会实现你的请求的。

Sometime later, after Xiren guided the child out of the classroom, I found Jia Xichun whispering something to herself.
袭人把孩子带走后……贾惜春低语着些什么。

You've got a lot on your plate, huh... Dealing with Restructuring Days is just one of them.
除了重构日……需要处理的问题仍旧堆积如山啊。

Hmph, I was going to try to improve the safety of this place anyway, whether he asked me to or not.
嗯……那种事，就算他不来拜托，我也打算要处理的。

dataList.content:
Safe enough for a kid like that to run around the market all on his own... A place where he doesn't have to be afraid to go outside...
要安全到让那样的小不点在市场里走来走去也不会有问题……成为一个不会让他感到害怕的地方……
